title: A twenty-minute pass: get found, then survive ten seconds
takeaway: Fix what a recruiter's search and first ten seconds see - headline, About's first lines, skills, location - before any polish.
sources: Your LinkedIn does one job: get found, and survive the ten seconds after.
Recruiters search by keyword, and your headline is heavily weighted in that search.
A blank or vague location removes you from most searches.
That is most of the available value.

items.ifSkipped: Aspiring, enthusiast and passionate match no search anybody runs

items.item: First two lines of About define you
items.ifSkipped: About is cut after about two lines on mobile; the rest goes unread
Recruiters filter on the top three, shown prominently
A blank or vague location removes you from most searches
You lose the only link somebody will actually click

items.item: Open to work, recruiter-only if employed
items.ifSkipped: Blank titles and locations there mean you do not appear
